statement: RmlUi source delivery binds the immutable pin and exact patch to a complete upstream identity manifest in vendor/rmlui/rmlui-6.1-source.json, owned workspace and readiness receipt. Configure callers explicitly bind CMake to the bootstrap interpreter without changing serialized root equality. The manifest retains LF checkout bytes and selects both Python and native CI lanes. Registered Python controls check full-file preservation and read-only repetition; the separate command contract checks workspace ownership and command refusals. Generated command equivalence, supported CMake versions, Windows and native builds require separate execution.
